content.user_title: Design Mobile App Screens with Sleek
content.value_statement: Mobile app design requests often need project setup, iterative screen changes, and screenshots. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Sleek API workflows for mobile app UI generation.
actual_capabilities: Create and manage Sleek projects through documented API endpoints.
Send natural language design prompts to generate or update mobile screens.
Poll asynchronous chat runs and handle sync wait responses.
List project components and select target screens for edits.
Render individual or combined screenshots for created and updated screens.
Apply pagination, idempotency, and conflict-handling guidance.
limitations: Requires a SLEEK_API_KEY and Pro+ API access.
Sends prompts and optional reference image URLs to Sleek services.
Only supports HTTPS reference images and documented Sleek endpoints.
Does not include executable client code or a local design renderer.

use_cases.title: Create a New App Concept
use_cases.description: Turn a short product idea into a Sleek project with generated mobile screens and screenshots.

use_cases.title: Iterate Existing Screens
use_cases.description: Send focused update prompts to refine a selected screen and review the updated screenshot.

use_cases.title: Document Design Progress
use_cases.description: List components, capture screenshots, and share visual progress after each completed design run.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple App
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Sleek project for a budgeting app and generate the first mobile screen. Show me the screenshot after it finishes.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Several Screens
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a broader first design pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a mobile onboarding flow for a meditation app with welcome, goal selection, and subscription screens.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Target Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine a known screen in an existing project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the profile screen in my Sleek project, make it cleaner, and show the updated screenshot.

prompt_templates.title: Run an Advanced Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Use polling, idempotency, and combined screenshots.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a travel planner app concept, poll until complete, capture each new screen, and include one combined screenshot of all screens.

output_examples.input: Design a fitness tracking app with a dashboard screen.
output: Created a Sleek project for the fitness tracking app.
Submitted the dashboard design request and waited for completion.
Returned an individual screenshot of the generated dashboard screen.

output_examples.input: Update the settings screen to look more premium.
output: Located the settings screen in the selected project.
Sent a focused update request to Sleek for that screen.
Returned the refreshed screenshot after the run completed.

output_examples.input: Show me all screens in the project after the new flow is created.
output_examples.output: The response includes screenshots for each new screen and a combined project screenshot for review.

best_practices: Use the smallest API key scope set needed for the requested task.
Show screenshots after each completed screen creation or update run.
Use idempotency keys when retrying a message after a network failure.
anti_patterns: Do not send sensitive reference image URLs unless the user approves.
Do not start another chat run before the active run completes.
Do not assume a result exists while a run is still queued or running.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an AI agent through Sleek API workflows for mobile app screen generation, updates, and screenshots.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires SLEEK_API_KEY and API access on a supported Sleek plan.

faq.question: Can it edit existing screens?
faq.answer: Yes. It can target a known screen, send an edit prompt, and return the updated screenshot.

faq.question: Does it create screenshots automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow instructs the agent to capture screenshots after completed screen creation or update operations.

faq.question: Where does data go?
faq.answer: Requests are directed to Sleek endpoints. Prompts and optional image URLs are processed by Sleek services.

faq.question: Can it work without network access?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflows require HTTPS requests to the Sleek API.
